''' Tareen Sava''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who was employed by [[Galactic Solutions Industries]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the events of the [[Conquest of Makeb]], she was stationed on [[Gravity Hook Seven]]'s loading ring, supplying company wares to the Imperial strike team.
